items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Sarah Vaughn worked out there with us; that's when Black Coffee came out

ctx.x: And we would play all the big band arrangements, and so all the bands would come and hear us, because I was a stickler for 7 pieces, because you could always get the big band sound out of 7 pieces, if it's voiced correctly.

Let's see ... Sarah Vaughn worked out there with us; that's when Black Coffee came out -- now whatever year "Black Coffee" was very popular, that's when I was there. That's when she was doing "Black Coffee".
You know, that was almost, like, '50, wasn't it?
